instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: If you want to be able to reopen and edit a document you have been working on, you need to save it. If you forget to save the document, then your text, or any changes to the text, could be lost.

atoms.a: Select two reasons why it is important to save your documents.
b: ++So you can edit your document later on.
So you can print your document.

atoms.a: What can happen if you forget to save a document?
b: ++The text or changes to the text can be lost.

feedback.end: The 'File' button opens a menu. From here, you can use many functions of the writing program.
This will save your text as a new document. You will usually be asked to name your document and choose a place to save it.
If your document is new, this button will work the same as the 'Save as' button. If you are editing an old document, this button will save it in the same place and under the same name as before.
It is helpful to organise your documents into groups based on what topics they cover or what they are used for.
Brilliant! Now your document has been saved.

instruction.text: Select all correct buttons from the menu for each situation.

atoms.a: You want to save a new document.
You want to save changes to a document as a new file.
You want to save changes in the same file.

instruction.text: Choose the best file name for each document.

feedback.wrong: Try to avoid naming files with names that are too generic. For example, when naming your homework, be specific about the topic or subject so that you can easily spot which homework file is the one you need.

hint.text: Files are often saved using underscores (_) instead of spaces. This is because most programs don’t accept files with spaces in the name.
hint.sound: Files are often saved using underscores, instead of spaces. This is because most programs don’t accept files with spaces in the name.
hint.label: Underscore (_)

feedback.correct: Great! When naming files, remember to label them clearly so that you can easily tell which files are which.
